notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.19.1
notes.notes:
[p]Hello all,[/p][p]We’re pushing a small patch to address a few issues, add some new content, and make minor improvements.[/p][p][b]
New Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new units: [/p][list][*][p][b]Bone Wraith, [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Skeleton Knight[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Skeleton Marksman[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dark Necromancer[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Modified the way the [b]Potential UI[/b] is displayed for better clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where summoned units did not correctly set their dodge position.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some in-game text with grammar errors.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve also updated our feedback form for reporting bugs and issues. You can find it here: [url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H5EaujuY5xqV2gCMVqN4d-iwkpKnUQ8zXHeZJzAdXA0/edit?gid=0#gid=0"]Mini Dungeons Feedback Form [/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your continued support and feedback![/p][p]— The Mini Dungeons Team[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix v0.18.3
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,

We’re releasing a hotfix to address a couple of issues found in-game. A larger patch is scheduled for release in the coming weeks.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Cheat Mode appeared in-game.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Expanded the notification bar to support longer text.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.18.2
notes.notes: [p]Hello all! We've been hard at work fixing bugs and issues since launch. Below is a list of all the changes we've implemented. Thank you to everyone who's supported us and left feedback since launch! [/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new Arm item, [i]Shield[/i], which increases defence and enables the Defend action.[/p][/*][*][p]Added six Level 6 items that were previously missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing video content.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sound effects and background music.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated Pyro’s Grand Ceremony to address lag during Quick Time Events (QTEs).[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Ghoul damage by 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Potential Info UI by increasing its size.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted values for several potentials.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the lighting for certain candles in Level 1.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player disappears after a game over.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where items not equipped could still be sold.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain object pools were not functioning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Mirror object in Vin’s [i]Shadow Dance[/i] ability didn’t work.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a chest bug where unique items would not generate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing unique items to degrade to a lower level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the weapon merchant not offering weapon slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input delay when interacting with NPCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed long loading times.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Mini Dungeons is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re incredibly excited to announce that [b]Mini Dungeons[/b] is officially available in [b]Early Access[/b] on Steam![/p][p]After months of development, testing, and community feedback, we're finally ready to invite you into our world. This is just the beginning—and your input will help shape what’s to come.[/p][previewyoutube="z3i4BPJLvVQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]What to Expect[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Turn-Based Combat.[/b] Engage in turn-based combat where every decision counts. Plan your moves carefully to outwit enemies and survive the dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Procedurally Generated Dungeons.[/b] Explore dynamically generated levels each time you enter the dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot and Upgrade.[/b] Discover and collect powerful weapons and armour during your journey. Equip them to strategically increase your chances of survival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Release Sealed Potential.[/b] Releasing a character's sealed potential. Interact with an Altar to obtain powerful boons to unlock unique skills and abilities tailored for different playstyles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Challenging Boss Fights.[/b] Confront challenging bosses that will test your skills and strategy. Adapt and overcome these difficult encounters.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What’s Coming Next?[/b]
We have big plans for future updates, including:[/p][list][*][p][i]Refined Gameplay loop.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Dungeon effects and events [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Dialogue System + Cutscenes.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]More Equipment and skill systems.[/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]More Party Members.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Minigames[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Endgame Dungeon Content.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]We’d love to hear what you think! Share your feedback, report bugs, or just hang out with us in the Steam Discussions.[/p]
